title: Meet Slidekick
objective: Deck makers install Slidekick and try it on their next deck.

audience.who: Founders, PMs, marketers and consultants who make decks
audience.context: product launch: README gallery, landing page and short talks
objections: It will look different in PowerPoint

tone: confident, plain-spoken, launch energy without hype
big_idea: Slidekick gives you a real PowerPoint deck: native objects, your brand, checked in PowerPoint before you see it.

beats.message: Slidekick turns a brief and your brand kit into a PowerPoint deck you can edit.
Decks still take a day, and most AI tools hand back pictures of slides.
You give it a brief and your brand kit, and you get back an editable deck.
Every word, chart and table is native PowerPoint.
It builds from your kit: template, logos, colours, fonts and rules.
Every build is rendered in real PowerPoint and checked against the design.
Text lands exactly where it was designed, and every transition and animation is read back from PowerPoint.
It creates decks, edits yours in place, and reviews any deck.
A fresh-eyes reviewer scores the design before anything ships.
Install it and try it on your next deck.
